neighbours.label: 'a certain' as an unspecified amount or kind ('a certain size', 'a certain way'), not 'certain' meaning sure
fire: She walked in with a certain idea about the plan.
People behave a certain way when hungry.
A phone may have a battery of a certain size.
It carries a certain amount of danger.
He has a certain charm about him.
The shoes wear out after a certain time.
There is a certain kind of person who loves this.
The water must reach a certain level.
quiet: She walked in with a clear idea about the plan.
A phone may have a battery of a small size.
It carries a large amount of danger.
I am certain that he has gone.
The shoes wear out after a long time.
She is quite certain about the result.
The water must reach the top level.

predictions: ' certain' after 'a' fires; plain adjectives and 'certain' meaning sure stay quiet.
